model_annotation:
The graph shows the inconsistency of target endpoint prediction probability distributions during the MuST-C English-German training process. 

The x-axis is labeled "迭代次数" (Iteration Times), with a numerical scale ranging from 0 to 30, marked at intervals of 5, and no units specified.

The y-axis is labeled "目标端预测概率分布不一致程度" (Inconsistency of Target Endpoint Prediction Probability Distribution), with a numerical scale ranging from 0 to 1.2, and no units specified.

There are two lines in the graph: one is blue and has a solid line style with square markers, and the other is orange and has a solid line style with circle markers. 

The blue line starts at approximately (0, 1.2) and decreases sharply to around (2, 0.45), then gradually decreases to approximately (30, 0.42). 

The orange line starts at approximately (0, 0.98) and decreases sharply to around (2, 0.42), then gradually decreases to approximately (30, 0.40).
